fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The top level response error code.

fields.name: ReplicaElectionResults
fields.about: The election results, or an empty array if the requester did not have permission and the request asks for all partitions.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The result error, or zero if there was no error.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The result message, or null if there was no error.
